items.heading: Ambuyat
details: Key ingredients: sago starch, water, dipping sauce (cacah)
Stir sago starch into boiling water, mixing briskly until it turns glutinous and sticky.
Continue stirring until the starch forms a translucent, gluey paste.
Prepare a tangy, sour-spicy dipping sauce called cacah.
Twirl small amounts of the starch onto chopsticks and dip before eating.

items.heading: Nasi Katok
details: Key ingredients: rice, fried chicken, sambal, cucumber
Steam a portion of fragrant rice.
Deep-fry marinated chicken pieces until crisp and golden.
Prepare a simple spicy sambal sauce.
Plate the rice with fried chicken, sambal and cucumber slices.
